headline: Multiple crude bomb blasts hit Dhaka as school bus torched
summary: Attacks targeted the CID headquarters, Pallabi police station, and Dhaka University, while a school bus was set on fire in Vatara.
details: Multiple crude bomb explosions were reported across various parts of Dhaka, including the CID headquarters in Malibagh, Pallabi police station, and Mirpur-1.
In Vatara, attackers set fire to a school bus belonging to Jalsidi Cantonment School and College that was parked on the roadside.
Several crude bomb blasts were also heard in the Dhaka University area, leading to the detention of three individuals.
A bomb attack at the Pallabi police station reportedly wounded an SRB member.
The violence has caused widespread panic as multiple locations were targeted in coordinated attacks across the capital city.
caption:
Multiple crude bomb blasts and a torched school bus. Dhaka is under attack.

Multiple crude bomb explosions were reported across various parts of Dhaka, including the CID headquarters in Malibagh, Pallabi police station, and Mirpur-1.

In Vatara, attackers set fire to a school bus belonging to Jalsidi Cantonment School and College that was parked on the roadside.

Several crude bomb blasts were also heard in the Dhaka University area, leading to the detention of three individuals.

A bomb attack at the Pallabi police station reportedly wounded an SRB member.

The violence has caused widespread panic as multiple locations were targeted in coordinated attacks across the capital city.

#Dhaka #Bangladesh #Security #BreakingNews #DhakaUniversity

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com

headline_marked: 3 [[Dhaka Tribune journalists held hostage]] by drug gang in Tongi
headline: 3 Dhaka Tribune journalists held hostage by drug gang in Tongi
summary: The journalists were allegedly tortured at gunpoint and forced to drink a sedative liquid for three hours before being released.
details: Three Dhaka Tribune journalists—reporters Rabiul Hasan and Asiful Islam Rifat, and photojournalist Abir Ahmed Supto—were attacked by armed assailants in Tongi, Gazipur.
caption:
Three journalists were held hostage for three hours, tortured at gunpoint, and forced to drink sedatives by a drug gang.

Three Dhaka Tribune journalists—reporters Rabiul Hasan and Asiful Islam Rifat, and photojournalist Abir Ahmed Supto—were attacked by armed assailants in Tongi, Gazipur.
